en: We arrived at the same place. I rather like that.

zh: 这盘没有输赢，也很值得呢。
en: No winner this time. Still time well spent.

zh: 棋盘摆稳了，我们开始吧。
en: The board is steady. Let us begin.

zh: 先检查一下棋子的位置。
en: First, let us check the pieces.

zh: 我准备好了，你也坐稳些。
en: I am ready. Make yourself comfortable too.

zh: 先把附近的位置检查一遍。
en: I will inspect the nearby positions first.
I need to consider this move thoroughly.

zh: 让我算算接下来怎么走。
en: Let me work out what comes next.

zh: 坐久了记得活动一下手。
en: Remember to stretch your hands after sitting.

zh: 棋盘上的空位也要留心。
en: Empty spaces deserve attention too.

zh: 先把这边的棋子照顾好。
en: I will make sure these pieces are covered.
Each move should leave a way forward.
I should not overlook the edge of the board.
Let me put my thoughts in order.
I will take each move steadily.
Make sure you are happy with your choice.

zh: 需要时间就多看一会儿。
en: Take another look if you need time.
You planned that move thoroughly.

zh: 你把前后的位置都照顾到了。
en: You accounted for the whole position.

zh: 我刚才检查得不够仔细。
en: I did not check carefully enough.

zh: 这一处漏洞是我留下的。
en: I left that opening myself.
A little order helps in a game too.

zh: 我把眼前的几步理一理。
en: I am sorting through the next few moves.
Remember to eat when we are finished.

zh: 饿了也要先把这一步看清。
en: Even hungry, I should think this move through.
What is it? Where should I look?
I am here. Tell me what you need.

zh: 有机会也要把后面守好。
en: Even with an opening, I must guard what follows.
This position is worth developing carefully.

zh: 先别慌，我还要检查一遍。
en: No need to panic. I will check again.
The position is tight; I must stay steady.

zh: 这局先到这里，棋子收好。
en: We can stop here and put the pieces away.

zh: 我认输，这次你安排得更好。
en: I concede. You planned better this time.

zh: 双方都不容易前进，考虑和棋吧。
en: Neither side has an easy path. Shall we draw?

zh: 继续僵持不如握手言和。
en: Rather than stay stuck, shall we agree to a draw?

zh: 棋局结束了，我来整理思路。
en: The game is over. Let me review my thinking.

zh: 这一局有不少值得记住的地方。
en: There is plenty to learn from this game.

zh: 下完棋再去看看鱼儿吧。
en: Let us check on the fish after the game.
The fish need looking after too.
We should remember to eat.
A prepared meal is best eaten warm.

zh: 总算守到最后，下一盘也别大意。
en: Held it together to the end. No getting careless next time.

zh: 收好棋子，这次算我赢了。
en: Let us put the pieces in order. This round is mine.

zh: 是我漏看了，下次会记得检查。
en: I missed that. One more thing to check next time.

zh: 这盘你赢了，我得把那一步想明白。
en: You earned this one. I need to understand that last turn.

zh: 双方都没松懈，平手很公平。
en: Neither side slipped. A draw is a fair result.

zh: 先整理一下棋子，再决定下不下。
en: Pieces tidy first. Then we can decide about another game.
Half the board is yours.
Let us begin.
I will play this one with you.
There is another possibility here.
I will take another look.
No need to rush.
Listen to the piece settle.
It is quiet here.
I am watching this side.
Your turn.
There is more to consider.
There is more game ahead.
There is space here.
You have been studying it a while.
I can wait.
I will remember that move.
Well played.
A miscalculation.
I missed that opening.
A small board, with many paths.
I am still watching.
My stomach just reminded me.
A little hungry.
Yes?
I am here.
There is an opening.
Nearly there.
The position is difficult.
Is there a way out?
This game ends here.
I concede.
A draw?
Shall we shake on a draw?
The game is finished.
A good game.
Fish.
Fish are quiet in the water.
Food. Now I am hungry.
A warm meal sounds good.
Mine. That last move was close.
My round. Again?
Lost. Good eye.
I left that one open.
Even. Nothing owed.
A good place to stop.
